title: List all Subusers for a parent response

disabled.description: Whether or not the user is enabled or disabled.

username.description: The name by which this subuser will be referred.

email.description: The email address to contact this subuser.

region.description: The region this Subuser is assigned to. This property is returned only if the `include_region` parameter was included and set to `true` in the API request.
